units.source_text: 老师本来胖乎乎的脸，异样地绷得紧紧的，

en.t: The teacher's normally plump face was strangely drawn tight,

units.source_text: 大概是由于一见到我不得不跟我说话这样一种不愉快的情绪所导致的呼。

en.t: probably because of the unpleasant feeling that, the moment he saw me, he had no choice but to speak with me.

units.source_text: 而我呢，看到老师的眼睛像看麻风病人似地望着我的时候，我就感到异常的痛快。

en.t: As for me, when I saw the teacher looking at me with eyes like those used to look at a leper, I felt an extraordinary satisfaction.

units.source_text: 因为这正是我所期待的充满人的感情的眼睛。

en.t: Because these were exactly the eyes full of human feeling that I had been waiting for.
